 [重要通知]
- 领取门票：酒店内的Play&Stay票务柜台（上午9点至12点）
- 本商品的门票仅限购票人本人使用，严禁转让或由他人代领。
- 仅限购买者本人办理入住后方可使用酒店住宿服务，如入住者中包含未成年人，须由法定监护人陪同入住。
- 本商品中所标注的所有时间均以韩国标准时间（KST）为准
- Play&Stay 班车出发时间可于演出当天在酒店确认。
- Play&Stay 接驳巴士服务仅向购买本商品（一人套票或者双人套票）的顾客提供，仅可在所购商品对应的演出当日使用。

※ According to the terms on the notice of this concert, ticket reservations will be canceled for cases where abnormal or fraudulent methods(e.g., using a macro program, etc.) have been detected in the ticket purchasing process.

※ By making a ticket reservation, you are accepting the terms in this notice. These terms are subject to change depending on event circumstances. Please check the information carefully before attending the concert to ensure that you are not adversely affected in any way.

［Restricted View Seating Notice］
▶ Section: Portions of Sections 102, 202, 114, 214, 314
▶ Please be advised that these seats may have partially obstructed views or limited sound quality, depending on their location and individual viewing preferences, due to venue structures or equipment.
We strongly recommend that you consider this carefully before making your purchase.
Please note that cancellations, changes, or refunds will NOT be permitted on the day of the concert due to any issues related to restricted view or sound from these seats. The event organizer and ticketing platform are not responsible for any inconvenience caused.

[Identity Verification]
* The identity of every guest will be verified on-site to prevent ticket scalping and illegal transfers.
- NOL World reservations must be made using the attendee's account, including for customers under 14 years old.

※ You can only reserve the ticket with your verified account to prevent unauthorized use by a third party.
- Please make sure that you verify your identity before the reservation of the concert ticket.
- Please prepare your passport before the identity verification. (*Using Korean passport for the verification is not possible)
(Go to FAQs : https://world.nol.com/en/my-info/faqs?selected-category=verified-member)

※ You can only receive one queue order with one account.
If you create a queue using multiple devices or browsers at the same time, your existing queue will be automatically closed.
(Go to FAQs : https://world.nol.com/en/my-info/faqs?selected-category=booking-payment)

※ For more information, please contact the NOL World Customer Center. ［My Account］ 〉 ［Customer Support］

[ 使用指南 ]
- 预约确认：通过My Page或E-mail确认
- 与本商品有关的疑问，请通过My Page > FAQ 联系客服 利用
 
[ 取消相关规定 ]
- 可直接通过我的页面>预定/取消明细内进行取消。
- 住宿和演出取消将同时进行，不可部分取消。
- 取消手续费
自购票后第8日起至演出日前17天，每笔收取4,000韩元
参观日8~16日前取消时手续费 60%
参观日4~7日前取消时手续费 90%
从参观日3日前开始，参观日 当天取消时手续费100%不可退还
